sample_1.prompt: A young woman curled up on a cozy armchair in a sunlit reading nook, the last page of a thick novel held triumphantly in her hands, a satisfied grin on her face. An empty mug of tea sits on the side table. Soft natural light from a nearby window. Photorealistic style, shallow depth of field, warm cozy tones, cinematic composition.

sample_2.prompt: A jubilant office team standing together in a modern conference room, arms raised and champagne glasses clinking after landing a major contract. A large presentation screen behind them shows a winning graph. Confetti falls lightly. Photorealistic style, shallow depth of field, bright warm tones, cinematic wide composition.

sample_3.prompt: A diligent young man at a long boardroom table, the only person remaining after a long meeting, surrounded by neat handwritten notes covering multiple pages. His expression is focused and content. Empty chairs and coffee cups fill the background. Photorealistic style, shallow depth of field, cool neutral tones, cinematic composition.
